title: memcpy length from packet field without bound check
description: PACKET_PARSER | calls: memcpy | vuln: memcpy called with length derived from untrusted packet field without upper bound validation, classic stack or heap buffer overflow via oversized field value

title: command injection via user-controlled string in shell call
description: CMD_EXEC | calls: system popen | vuln: command string assembled via sprintf from user-controlled input, passed directly to system or popen without sanitization, shell metacharacter injection

title: integer overflow in allocation size arithmetic
description: ALLOC | calls: malloc calloc | vuln: integer overflow in multiplication or addition of size fields before allocation, attacker-controlled count wraps to small allocation, subsequent write overflows heap

title: use-after-free in connection teardown path
description: CONN_HANDLER | calls: free | vuln: pointer freed in error path then accessed in cleanup, use-after-free on connection object, exploitable for heap corruption or info leak

title: uncontrolled format string from user input
description: LOG_FUNC | calls: printf fprintf syslog | vuln: user-controlled string passed as format argument without format specifier, allows stack read or write via format directives

title: out-of-bounds read in TLV field parsing
description: TLV_PARSER | calls: memcpy memmove | vuln: TLV length field read from packet without bounds check against remaining buffer length, out-of-bounds read exposes heap or stack memory

title: null pointer dereference on failed allocation
description: ALLOC_HANDLER | calls: malloc strdup | vuln: return value of malloc or strdup not checked before dereference, null pointer dereference on allocation failure causes crash or pre-auth denial of service

title: strcpy or strcat into fixed-size buffer
description: STRUTIL | calls: strcpy strcat | vuln: strcpy or strcat copies user-controlled string into fixed-size stack buffer without length check, stack buffer overflow

title: certificate validation bypass in TLS handshake
description: TLS_HANDSHAKE | calls: SSL_verify X509_verify | vuln: certificate chain validation result not checked or overridden, allows MitM via forged certificate

title: stack memory disclosure via partial buffer copy
description: RESP_BUILDER | calls: memcpy send | vuln: response buffer not fully initialized before copy, uninitialized stack or heap bytes leaked to remote attacker via partial copy

title: OpenSSL BN_mod_sqrt infinite loop denial of service
description: OPENSSL_TLS | calls: BN_mod_sqrt EC_POINT_oct2point | vuln: malformed EC certificate triggers infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt during TLS handshake, pre-auth denial of service, CVE-2022-0778

title: SQL injection in FMC report parameter handling
description: REPORT_HANDLER | calls: sqlite3_exec mysql_query | vuln: report filter parameter concatenated into SQL query without parameterization, authenticated SQL injection in management interface

title: Go exec.Command with user-controlled arguments
description: GO_SUBPROCESS | calls: exec.Command os.StartProcess | vuln: user-controlled string passed as argument to exec.Command without sanitization, argument injection or command injection depending on shell flag

title: goroutine leak or unbounded channel fill from untrusted input
description: GO_GOROUTINE | calls: go_routine chan_send | vuln: attacker-controlled input causes unbounded goroutine spawn or channel block, resource exhaustion denial of service

title: PHP exec call with user-controlled FQDN or parameter
description: PHP_EXEC | calls: exec shell_exec system | vuln: user-controlled parameter (FQDN, file path, regex) passed to PHP exec or shell_exec without sanitization, pre-auth or post-auth command injection

title: unrestricted file upload via FCTDas with PE signature bypass
description: UPLOAD_WORKER | calls: osslsigncode file_put_contents | vuln: PE file uploaded without authenticode signature verification, signature check absent or bypassable, allows unsigned binary execution on managed endpoints

title: path traversal in file read or write operation
description: FILE_HANDLER | calls: fopen open realpath | vuln: user-supplied filename not canonicalized before open, path traversal via ../ sequences reads or writes files outside intended directory

title: TOCTOU race in file permission check before open
description: FILE_ACCESS | calls: access stat open | vuln: permission check via access or stat followed by open on same path, race condition between check and use allows privilege escalation

title: authentication bypass via predictable session token
description: AUTH_HANDLER | calls: rand srand time | vuln: session token or nonce generated with predictable seed from time or pid, allows token prediction and authentication bypass
